title: Daily Brief — Morning Edition — Sunday, 22 November 2026
description: Anthropic releases its new Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 AI models, Canberra and the Coalition spar over the outlook for household energy bills, Queensland unveils a new masterplan for the Prince Charles Hospital, and the Gold Coast's visitor economy hits a record $8.9 billion. 한국어로도 브리핑을 전해드립니다.
